interface.signature: def criticalConnections(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(adj[i]) <= V for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: Each vertex must have at least one edge and at most V-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= neighbor < V for neighbor in adj[i]) for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: All neighbors in the adjacency list must be valid vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(set(tuple(sorted(edge)) for edge in return_value))
postconditions.description: The returned list of critical connections must not contain duplicate edges.

postconditions.expression: all(edge[0] < edge[1] for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each edge in the returned list must be in sorted order.

postconditions.expression: all(any(edge in adj[i] for i in range(V)) for edge in return_value)
postconditions.description: All returned edges must exist in the original adjacency list.
